source.transcription: Midpoints and limits of the printed certified-result columns, visually checked on PDF pages 7 and 10; software-result and yes/no columns are not reference data
caveats: The vendor software-result column gives 11.01 dB outside its own printed 13.63-13.73 dB interval for T06/T19 at 63 Hz. Those results and yes/no assertions are not adopted.
These reported corrections supplement the unchanged original fixture. They do not establish 2024 conformity or certify the current engine.
